unit.why: A short narrative: a man in Hungary asks R. Moshe (of Sambor? uncle of the Zhidachov rebbe) for help, is told he will be helped 'in socks, not shoes', and is saved right after the tzaddik's death.

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי אבי מורי הרב זצ"ל
stories.summary_en: A man in Hungary in need of great salvation asks R. Moshe for help; the tzaddik cryptically says he will help him not 'in shoes' but 'in socks', and indeed right after R. Moshe's death the man is saved.

tags.why: cryptic prediction fulfilled after the tzaddik's death
